thought: A good spot to catch my breath.
My feet have opinions about this road.
I wonder what is over that ridge.
We should have packed more food.
Still no idea where we are going.
That cloud looks like a bad omen.
Counting my coins again. Same answer.
Someone has to keep watch. Might as well be me.
This place smells older than it looks.
One day I will be paid for this.
greet: Evening. Seen anything strange around here?
Is there anywhere warm to eat nearby?
You live here? What is that like?
Which way is the nearest road?
reply: Strange is all we get here.
Keep to the road and you will be fine.
You are not from around here.
I have said too much already.
look: Huh. That has been here a while.
I have seen one of these before.
rest: Five minutes. That is all I ask.
Do not tell the others I sat down.
This is the best seat in the country.

hunger: I was starting to chew my own strap.
That will hold me until evening.
Do not look at me like that. I was hungry.
sleep: Wake me if the world ends.
I could sleep for a week.
hygiene: I had forgotten what my own hands looked like.
Three days of road, off at last.
Now I am fit to stand near people.
That water was colder than the grave.
social: That is the most I have said all week.
leisure: I needed that more than I knew.
Nobody tell the party how much I lost.
For a moment there I forgot the road.

corpse.prompt: Fallen comrade: {name}. What will you do?
corpse.nothingToLoot: There is nothing left to loot on {name}.
corpse.examined: You examine the anatomy and body condition of the fallen comrade.

grave.prompt: Grave of {name}. What will you do?
grave.desecrated: You desecrated the grave of {name}. Recovered bones and remaining personal belongings.

petting: You crouch down and scratch {name} behind the ears.
You rub {name} along the jaw, the way it likes.
You kneel and let {name} put its whole weight against you.
You scrub {name} between the shoulders with both hands.
You sit down in the road and make a proper fuss of {name}.
petted: {name} leans into your hand and refuses to be moved.
You scratch {name} where it cannot reach. It forgives you everything.
{name} bumps its head against your leg and settles.
{name} rolls over. This is apparently the correct response.
said: This road smells wrong to me.
Say the word and I go first.
I could eat. When could I not?
Do not leave me behind again.
There was something back there. It is gone now.
I like it better when we walk.
pet.stopped: {name} stays where it is and stops following you.
